Name: Animation Sprite Swap Framework
Author: Nikanor24
Description:
[list]
[/list]🧩 What It Does

This framework lets you [b]swap NPC sprites automatically[/b] when a specific [b]animation[/b] is triggered during a schedule animation like [i]alex_lift_weights[/i]
or [i]sam_guitar[/i].

It reads a simple data file (Sprites/animationDescriptions) that lists which animations should use which sprite sheets.
When the animation starts, the framework temporarily replaces the NPC’s texture. When it ends, the original sprite is restored automatically.

No events, no conditions, no complicated setup, just automatic sprite swapping.

It’s especially useful if you’re using other mods that load character sprites (like [i]Seasonal Cute Characters[/i]) but you still want specific animations to run with a different sprite.

⚙️ How To Use (for Modders)

Create or edit a [b]Content Patcher[/b] pack with a simple EditData patch:

[code]﻿{
  "Action": "EditData",
  "Target": "Sprites/animationDescriptions",
  "Entries": {
    "alex_lift_weights": "Characters/Alex_Tattoo",
    "sam_guitar": "Characters/Sam_BlackGuitar Portraits/Sam_BandShow"
  }
}
[/code]
Each key (e.g., "alex_lift_weights") is the [b]animation ID[/b] used in schedules or events.
Each value is the [b]path to the sprite sheet[/b] that should be loaded while that animation is playing.

When that animation runs in-game, the framework automatically:
[list=1]
[*]Replaces the NPC’s texture with your custom sprite.
[*]Restores the default sprite after the animation finishes.

[/list]That’s it. No coding required.

🧠 Notes for Modders[list]
[*]You can map [b]multiple animations per NPC[/b], even with different sprites.
[*]The animation key must [b]match exactly[/b] the one used by the game or your event/schedule (e.g., alex_lift_weights in Schedules/Alex).
[*]The sprite path must point to a valid game asset, like "Characters/Alex_Tattoo".
[*]This framework only manages the texture — it does [b]not[/b] add new animations, change frames, or edit timing.
[/list]

✅ Compatibility[list]
[*]Works with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]
[*]Works with [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b]
[*]Compatible with all mods that modify schedules or animations
[*]Safe to use alongside [b]Seasonal, Outfit, and Appearance[/b] mods
[*]No known conflicts with other frameworks
[/list]
